what: The 3D team's bank furniture models (banquet/, 8 GLB files received 3 Nov 2026) against the bank model: what each file holds, the piece it was exported from, its transform relative to that piece's box and block, its turn against the box turn and the block turn, and the pieces its family would furnish. Analysis only: nothing drawn in a browser, nothing timed.

inputs.drawings: I1201 / I1202 *.dwg converted with LibreDWG 0.14 dwg2dxf into a temp folder (not kept; byte for byte the same as the 26 Oct conversions); every furniture INSERT read back by its handle with ezdxf 1.4.4: 174 of the 185 pieces (the other 11 sit inside another block or are loose shapes, none in the 8 families here)
inputs.checkedWith: three.js 0.186.1 GLTFLoader (read from app/node_modules): the same triangles, vertices, attributes and world boxes, and every box / block matrix here puts its model back where it was exported (crosscheck.mjs)

frames.maxWorld: 3ds Max / DWG coordinates of bank_test/Bangkok_Bank_Sampeng.ms: metres, x east, y north, z up; L1 floor 0.00, L2 floor 3.70; = bank_furniture_list.csv x_m, y_m
frames.bankModelPlan: bank_model.json x, y = maxWorld x, y minus offset (1.212, 0.348)
frames.gltfScene: the GLB as loaded: y up, (x, y, z) = (max x, max z, -max y). The bank page's three.js world is (plan x, level + z, -plan y) = gltfScene + (-1.212, 0, +0.348) on level 1
frames.turns: degrees counter-clockwise seen from above, 0 = +x (east). A box rot is the turn of the box's long side, folded into 0-180 (0-90 for a square). A model's turn = the turn of its family's block drawing (front = the block's -Y) that gives the model as it stands; a front at angle a (the way it faces) is turn a + 90
frames.matrices: row-major 4 x 4, column vectors (v' = M v)

match.confidence: high for the run of four modules, medium for one piece
match.why: A 3.03 m long, 0.69 m deep backless bench on the run of four 1.0 x 0.7 m SOFA_BENCH_DIOR - TYPE 2 modules (L1-sofa-001 to -004, 4.0 m long): it fills the run's width exactly (x 5.327-6.020 against 5.322-6.022) and is centred on the run (30 mm off), but it is 0.97 m shorter, reaching from the middle of L1-sofa-001 to the middle of L1-sofa-004. So it was exported from the run, not from one piece: L1-sofa-002 is the nearest single piece (0.47 m), L1-sofa-003 the runner-up (0.53 m).
